notebook_section: B07 prepared practical comparison: reuse against the improved ordinary endpoint

first_256_episode_start_scale.definition: arithmetic mean of the three latent Gaussian scales at each actual episode start, averaged over the first 256 Bhalf training episodes

policy_definition.Bhalf: trainable scalar KEEP/END gate with zero initial logits, trainable initial latent scale 0.5, minimum-one/maximum-two-tick reactive command law
policy_definition.Ghalf: retained B06 checkpoint, frozen ordinary fresh phase-zero control
policy_definition.primary: Bhalf_sampled minus Ghalf_mean on paired new worlds

prepared_new_exposure.preparation_boundary: This implementation grants no launch; the twelve-fit owner ceiling is exhausted and execution requires a new explicit owner allocation plus admission.

inherited_exposure.qualification: B06 training and selection provenance is inherited, not replicated.

inherited_input.retained_selection_scope: Ghalf is a selected B06 instance reused without retraining; this is conditional selected-instance evidence, not a fresh G learning replicate.

panel.reading_scope: Conditional comparison with one newly trained Bhalf and the selected retained B06 Ghalf instance; world-panel SEs are not training-population precision.

fit_accounting.qualification: Prepared without launch authority. If separately allocated and admitted, every started Bhalf attempt counts and no failed attempt gains replacement allowance.

rng_isolation.qualification: Bhalf velocity and gate streams are private; no equality with the historical Ghalf final RNG state is claimed because B consumes fewer velocity draws.

telemetry.wall_scope: runner main entry through B07 publication accounting
telemetry.process_cpu_scope: study entry through B07 publication accounting
telemetry.external_scope: the native launch manifest is authoritative for actual-node and complete-process telemetry

resource_note: Telemetry scopes are explicit; unavailable complete-process telemetry limits only resource claims.
